reference_executor.allowed_reason: The existing bounded local action plane is needed to test the protocol deterministically and provide offline fallback.
reference_executor.new_capability_rule: Any new capability outside the reference scope requires a recorded build_vs_integrate_exception before implementation.

invariants: Adapter code translates observable boundaries; it does not copy an external agent runtime.
Canonical OS state remains authoritative; external session state is a pointer only.
No engineering gate or executor result upgrades claim, M/E, Owner acceptance or epistemic acceptance.
The Reference Executor remains bounded and provider-neutral.
OS deny cannot be overridden by external approval; the effective permission is the strict intersection.
